boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named SJU study environments, centered on Alcuin Library and the Dietrich Reinhart Learning Commons, with documented facilities and access notes.

cards.title: Alcuin Library
cards.subtitle: SJU campus · Abbey Plaza
cards.notes: Set up among the library collections, then use the Information Desk for research help or technology-loan questions before settling into your work.
cards.short_summary: The main SJU library, with collections and research-oriented services in one building.
cards.evidence_claim: Alcuin Library is Saint John’s library and includes media services, a computer public-access area, rare books, and the University Archives.
cards.access_notes: Library common areas are generally open to the public; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Dietrich Reinhart Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Connected to Alcuin Library · SJU campus
cards.notes: Choose this connected Learning Commons for flexible work, then pivot to nearby library services when your project needs research or technical help.
cards.short_summary: A Learning Commons with informal social-learning spaces and campus technology resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Reinhart Learning Commons provides flexible classrooms, technology, and informal social-learning spaces; it connects to Alcuin Library.
cards.source_title: Library and Learning Commons Tour | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Use during posted Alcuin Library and Learning Commons hours; common library areas are generally public.

cards.title: Alcuin Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Alcuin Library · reservable group space
cards.notes: Reserve a room for focused group work, and plan around the two-hour reservation limit rather than relying on an unbooked room being open.
cards.short_summary: Reservable library rooms for current CSB+SJU students, faculty, and staff.
cards.evidence_claim: Alcuin Library has reservable study and conference rooms; current students, faculty, and staff may reserve them for up to two hours per reservation.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current CSB+SJU students, faculty, and staff. Reservations are strongly encouraged; maximum is 2 hours per reservation and 4 hours daily.

cards.entity_name: Alcuin Library Computer Public Access Area
cards.title: Alcuin Library Computer Public Access Area
cards.subtitle: Alcuin Library · SJU campus
cards.notes: Use the computer public-access area when your task requires a campus workstation, and check library hours before making it your work base.
cards.short_summary: A library-based public computer area at Saint John’s.
cards.evidence_claim: The SJU buildings catalog lists a computer public-access area among Alcuin Library’s facilities.
cards.access_notes: Library computer labs are restricted to CSB+SJU students, faculty, and staff; verify current library hours.

cards.title: Alcuin Library Audio-Visual Rooms
cards.subtitle: Alcuin Library · SJU campus
cards.notes: Use the audio-visual rooms for media-centered coursework, and contact library or technology staff in advance if your project needs support.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated audiovisual facilities within Alcuin Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The SJU buildings catalog lists audio-visual rooms as part of Alcuin Library.
cards.access_notes: Media labs are restricted to CSB+SJU students, faculty, and staff; confirm room availability and library hours before use.

cards.title: The Study
cards.subtitle: Alcuin 371 · Academic Skills Center
cards.notes: Bring a current assignment or study plan to Alcuin 371 and use drop-in or scheduled peer academic coaching to work through next steps.
cards.short_summary: An academic-skills center with peer coaching and study-strategy support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Study’s Academic Skills Center is in SJU Alcuin 371 and offers drop-in or scheduled meetings with Peer Academic Coaches.
cards.source_title: The Study at CSB+SJU | Academic Success & Study Skills Resources
cards.access_notes: The university lists Sunday 3–9 p.m.; Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–9 p.m.; and Friday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. for The Study.

cards.title: CSB+SJU Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Alcuin Library · writing consultation space
cards.notes: Use a consultation to talk through a draft, then return to the library setting to revise while the assignment questions are still fresh.
cards.short_summary: A writing-support space in the Alcuin Library building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center is a building partner at Alcuin Library and provides free individual writing consultations with peer tutors.
cards.access_notes: Writing assistance is for members of the academic community; arrange or confirm consultation availability with the Writing Center.

cards.title: Learning Commons Video Studio
cards.subtitle: Dietrich Reinhart Learning Commons · SJU campus
cards.notes: Plan media coursework here when a video-production environment fits the assignment, and confirm equipment or staffing needs with Media Services first.
cards.short_summary: A named video-production facility in the SJU Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dietrich Reinhart Learning Commons includes a video studio.
cards.access_notes: Confirm availability and any Media Services requirements before use; library media labs are restricted to CSB+SJU students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Learning Commons Editing Lab
cards.subtitle: Dietrich Reinhart Learning Commons · SJU campus
cards.notes: Use the editing lab for a project that needs post-production tools, and allow time to save or export work before the library closes.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated editing environment within the SJU Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dietrich Reinhart Learning Commons includes an editing lab.
cards.access_notes: Confirm availability and any Media Services requirements before use; library media labs are restricted to CSB+SJU students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: McKeown Center
cards.subtitle: SJU campus · study and computer-lab areas
cards.notes: Use the center’s designated study, computer-lab, and lounge areas when you want a campus-center setting rather than a library desk.
cards.short_summary: A campus center with documented study space, computer lab, and lounge areas.
cards.evidence_claim: McKeown Center includes dining, study, computer-lab, recreational, and lounge areas.
cards.access_notes: Confirm building and computer-lab access with SJU before visiting, as public-access rules are not specified on the facilities listing.
